channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: David Muir Reflects on Dolly Parton's Life and Legacy
item.description: The music legend, actress, businesswoman, and philanthropist passed away at 80. Her career, rooted in Tennessee, spanned decades.

item.title: Ross Fire grows past 80,000 acres, triggers evacuations in North Texas
item.description: The Ross wildfire has scorched over 80,000 acres in Palo Pinto and Jack counties, leading to evacuations, road closures, and school disruptions.

item.title: Iran and Oman discuss Strait of Hormuz reopening, but Tehran demands U.S. lift blockade
item.description: The two nations, situated on opposite sides of the crucial waterway, talked about a plan to temporarily reopen it and remove mines.

item.title: USS Abraham Lincoln to make brief stop in Thailand after long deployment
item.description: The U.S. aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln will pause in Thailand en route home following an extended deployment in the Middle East.
